name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: UI SDK's Toggle, a button that stays pressed: tinted when on, in default, filled, outline and quiet (toolbar) variants with Button's sizes, with ToggleIcon and a controller; and ToggleGroup, toggles that share one value, single or multiple, one tab stop with arrow keys between them, as spaced toggles, a joined outline frame or Segmented's track (variant="segmented"), in a row or a column.
